metadata.title: MoxDOP Data Freshness Policy Registry V1
metadata.description: Dataset-specific freshness, maturity, reprocessing and incremental collection policy. Does not redefine provider fields or formulas. No global last-sync or global lookback.

provider_documentation.notes: Official docs: daily processing commonly 24-48h; reports may change after daily availability; some data can arrive late (up to ~7 days). Not a hard SLA — conservative safe lag 2 days; reprocess window 7 days.
